threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services, encrypts agency systems, and exfiltrates CJI and FTI from several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, landing zones, and admin paths connect all divisions; directory trust to the acquired consulting firm; full-scale restore untested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; SYS-D1 ACMP; SYS-D7 RMS; acquired firm estate
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM with no standing admin rights; immutable backups in provider B
treatment_plan: Retire the directory trust and migrate the acquired firm (GR-05); full-scale restore exercise; bulk-read alerts; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A CSA audit or IRS review finds unscreened shared-service or subcontractor staff with access to CJI or FTI, leading to sanctions, loss of access, or contract termination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening tracked per division, not for corporate; 212 of about 860 corporate staff and 23 subcontractor staff lack required checks or agreements
affected_asset_or_process: CJI and FTI environments (ACMP CJI cluster, FTI tenants, RMS)
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 PS-3; SA-9; Appendix H); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(2), I(8))
existing_controls: Division screening registers; CJIS training for GovTech staff
treatment_plan: One group screening register; suspend unscreened access by 2026-10-31; complete checks and certifications

threat_event: An incident spanning divisions misses an agency, DoD, or SEC notice clock (1-hour CJI, 24-hour FTI through agencies, 12-hour Florida ransomware, 72-hour DoD, 4-business-day Form 8-K)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Division runbooks differ; the group notification matrix is incomplete and unexercised; contacts for about 1,150 GovTech contracts not consolidated
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8); DFARS 252.204-7012(c); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
existing_controls: POL-03 1-hour internal reporting; SOC 24x7
treatment_plan: Complete the group notification matrix; cross-division tabletop with agency contacts; quarterly contact checks (P08)

threat_event: AI used in public benefit and criminal justice work produces wrong or biased outputs that shape decisions about people
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IEP assistant live before the Group AI Standard; bias testing incomplete; RMS AI assist beta without council review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 IEP AI assistant; SYS-D7 RMS AI assist
existing_controls: Caseworkers and officers decide; outputs labeled
treatment_plan: Group AI program (P10): council approval, bias testing, applicant notice, RMS beta paused for CJIS review

threat_event: Attackers use the acquired consulting firm's estate (weak VPN MFA, directory trust, no group EDR) to reach group systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Acquired firm VPN accepts SMS codes; directory trust to the group directory is live; endpoints outside group EDR and SIEM
existing_controls: Firewall rules on the trust; legacy antivirus
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA on the VPN now; EDR to all acquired endpoints; retire the trust at migration

threat_event: DoD awards after CMMC Phase 2 require Level 2 (C3PAO) status the division does not have, and DoD revenue is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No C3PAO assessment scheduled; CUI outside the enclave; inheritance undocumented
affected_asset_or_process: IT Consulting DoD work (about $630 million a year)
existing_controls: Enclave with a Basic self-assessment in SPRS
treatment_plan: Schedule a C3PAO assessment; close enclave gaps; move CUI into the enclave

threat_event: A full restore of the ACMP after ransomware takes far longer than the 8-hour contract RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restores tested per tenant only; sequential runbooks for about 430 tenants
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-4; CP-10); Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate; 8-hour RTO)
existing_controls: Immutable vault; quarterly per-tenant tests
treatment_plan: Parallel restore automation; full-scale exercise of the CJI cluster and 2 FTI tenants

threat_event: One corporate restore team and one backup vault design serve every division, so a group-wide event queues recoveries
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 60 backup operators; no surge agreement
existing_controls: Restore runbooks per system
treatment_plan: Recovery priority list across divisions (P05); surge support from the forensic retainer and provider professional services

threat_event: An IRS Office of Safeguards review finds common control logs for FTI systems kept less than 7 years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud control plane, identity, and EDR logs kept 2 years
existing_controls: FTI tenant application logs kept 7 years
treatment_plan: 7-year retention for FTI-relevant common control logs

threat_event: A CMMC assessor cannot rely on group common controls for the CUI enclave because inheritance is not documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control catalog exists, but no enclave inheritance matrix
existing_controls: Common control catalog (P02)
treatment_plan: Enclave inheritance matrix and SSP update
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: State CSAs find RMS connectors using FIPS 140-2 modules after the CJIS deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 connectors at agency premises cannot be upgraded before 2026-09-21
existing_controls: TLS 1.2 on all connector links
treatment_plan: Replace modules on all 41 connectors; agency-by-agency schedule shared with CSAs

threat_event: A provider A regional outage takes down every regulated workload at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All CJI, FTI, CUI, and federal workloads in provider A's government-community regions
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1; SYS-D2; SYS-D3; SYS-D5; SYS-D7; SYS-D8
existing_controls: Multi-zone deployments; second region tested for the ACMP shared cluster
treatment_plan: Second-region tests for the CJI cluster and RMS

threat_event: Insiders look up or disclose CJI or motor vehicle records for personal reasons
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Thousands of staff can reach records for support; lookup reviews vary by division
existing_controls: Role-based access; audit logs; sanctions
treatment_plan: Group insider analytics on record lookups; monthly reviews in every division

threat_event: A compromised shared CI/CD pipeline pushes malicious code into multi-tenant agency platforms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One CI/CD platform builds ACMP, IEP, MVSP, RMS, and Civic Suite
existing_controls: Signed commits and images; two approvals
treatment_plan: Build provenance attestations; isolated build runners per division

threat_event: The Grants Management federal edition loses its FedRAMP authorization through continuous monitoring failures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monthly deliverables met in 2026; staffing thin
existing_controls: Monthly scans and POA&M to the authorizing agency
treatment_plan: Monitor monthly; no added treatment

threat_event: The group files a late or inaccurate Form 8-K Item 1.05 after a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality depends on agency facts gathered by three divisions
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cyber; POL-03 escalation within 24 hours
treatment_plan: Materiality worksheet in the P08 runbook; include in the tabletop

threat_event: New state AI or privacy laws reach products used by agencies (for example Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01) before the group adapts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customers in 46 states; laws change often
affected_asset_or_process: IEP AI assistant; RMS AI assist; Civic Suite
existing_controls: Counsel watch list
treatment_plan: Quarterly legal watch; reassess before entering a new state

threat_event: A SYS-G1 identity outage stops all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts tested quarterly; vendor multi-region service
treatment_plan: Keep quarterly break-glass tests; add break-glass for the notification desk

threat_event: Agency data is accessed from outside the United States through a vendor or subcontractor, breaching CJIS and Pub. 1075 location rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor support models change; location terms checked at onboarding only
existing_controls: U.S.-only contract terms; location-based sign-in blocks
treatment_plan: Annual vendor attestations of U.S.-only access

threat_event: Shortage of staff screened for each state's CJIS requirements delays agency projects and support
threat_source: Labor market and screening lead times
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fingerprint processing per state takes weeks
existing_controls: Pre-screened pool for large states
treatment_plan: Shared screened pool across divisions with the group register
